verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS platform that processes customer conversation data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of model training. The only privacy-related item is a list of compliance certifications (SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 42001, etc.), which is an adjacent assurance and not a training-data opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
